milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted brown mushroom is placed at spawn-relative (3, 0, 4). The player must navigate within 5 blocks and face toward it (within 60°) to demonstrate they have visually located the object. This is preferred over position_inside_box because find tasks require the player to observe the target, not just be near it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown bed head is at spawn-relative (4, 0, 5) with foot at (4, 0, 6). Target is set to the head block. The player must be within 5 blocks and facing toward it (within 60°) to confirm visual discovery. The bed is adjacent to the mushroom so the player naturally finds it after the first milestone.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops it as an item into the player's inventory. The purple bed is on the elevated platform at (-5, 6, -11)/(-5, 6, -10). When broken by hand (no tool required), it drops as 'purple_bed' item. This is the most direct and reliable check for a mine task — the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses position_inside_box because this is a movement/traversal task — the player must physically fall from the elevated platform (Y=5-6) to ground level (Y=-1 to 0). The box covers the ground area below and around the platform (X: -10 to 0, Y: -1 to 0, Z: -14 to -5) where no stairs exist. Combined with the dependency that mine_purple_bed must complete first (requiring the player to be ON the platform at Y=6), being at ground level in this zone confirms the player fell off the platform rather than walked down the stairs (which are at Z=-4 to -9, outside the box's Z range on the south side).
